messages:
Alyssa (People Ops): Heads-up — Samir (starts Mon 3/30) needs onboarding loop closed out. I-9 completed, background check cleared, laptop & cloud access, and benefits enrollment scheduled. Who's owning each piece?
Jordan (IT): I can take laptop + cloud access. Will provision Monday AM and share device shipping/tracking. Need full name + personal email + manager confirm.
Carla (HR): I'll own I-9 intake and benefits invite. Samir must complete Section 1 before arrival and upload acceptable ID scans. Sending portal link now.
hr-bot: I-9 portal link sent to samir@example.com — expires in 7 days. Background check vendor (CheckFast) notified.
Samir (newhire): Thanks! I saw the portal link. Quick Q — what IDs are okay? I have a passport and driver's license.
Carla (HR): Both are fine. For I-9 you can use: passport alone OR driver's license + SSN card. If using DL+SSN, please upload clear photos of both.
Alyssa (People Ops): Also to schedule benefits orientation, what's everyone's availability Thursday afternoon? We run the 30-minute benefits overview + enrollment walkthrough.
Maya (Hiring Manager): Thursday 2pm PT works for me. Please invite Samir and add the benefits packet to the invite.
Jordan (IT): @Alyssa sending the access checklist. For cloud access I need Samir's company email to add to org. Also: MFA enforced, please expect an Okta invite.
Alyssa (People Ops): Samir, we'll create your company email by EOD Fri. Carla, I'll forward the g-drive folder for the benefits packet and open enrollment links.
Carla (HR): BG check note: CheckFast usually returns results within 24-72 hours. If anything flags, I'll loop security and hiring manager.
Samir (newhire): Great — I'll complete I-9 today and upload passport. Also happy to join Thurs 2pm PT.
Jordan (IT): Device provisioning commands (for internal reference):
```
# provisioning outline
create-device --asset-type laptop --os macOS
assign-user --email samir@redwood.com --okta
install-agent --profile standard-dev
```
Alyssa (People Ops): Perfect. Action items: Jordan = laptop & cloud; Carla = I-9 + benefits invite; Alyssa = email + calendar invites; Samir = complete I-9 & upload ID. We'll confirm bg check by end of day. :party_parrot:
Maya (Hiring Manager): Thanks team. Please add me to any follow-ups.
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: if I-9 not completed in 48h, automated reminder to Samir and Alyssa.
Samir (newhire): Uploaded passport images and completed Section 1. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
